question: Can you identify the hubs that saw more than a 20% increase in finished orders from February to March?
sql:
WITH feb_march AS (
  SELECT 
    s.hub_id,
    o.order_created_month,
    COUNT(*) AS finished_orders
  FROM orders o
  JOIN stores s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
  WHERE o.order_status = 'FINISHED'
    AND o.order_created_month IN (2, 3)
  GROUP BY s.hub_id, o.order_created_month
),
pivot_data AS (
  SELECT 
    hub_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN order_created_month = 2 THEN finished_orders END) AS feb_orders,
    MAX(CASE WHEN order_created_month = 3 THEN finished_orders END) AS mar_orders
  FROM feb_march
  GROUP BY hub_id
)
SELECT 
  h.hub_name,
  feb_orders,
  mar_orders,
  ROUND(1.0 * (mar_orders - feb_orders) / feb_orders * 100, 2) AS pct_increase
FROM pivot_data pd
JOIN hubs h ON pd.hub_id = h.hub_id
WHERE feb_orders > 0
  AND 1.0 * (mar_orders - feb_orders) / feb_orders > 0.20
ORDER BY pct_increase DESC
